seo.title: Scuba Diving Koh Lanta, Courses and Dives | Secret Travel
seo.metaDescription: Scuba diving on Koh Lanta: first dive from 4,500 THB, fun dives at Koh Haa and Phi Phi, catamaran trips and SSI courses to Rescue. Small groups, hotel transfer.

lead: Try diving for a day, or train from your first breath to advanced diver. Small groups, a professional instructor and the reefs of the Andaman Sea.

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Scuba Explorer. Two supervised dives to 5 metres, from age 8, with two students per instructor at most. No experience needed.

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Discover Basic Diver. Breakfast and a briefing on the basic theory and safety rules, then the equipment and a few skills in shallow water, then two dives to 12 metres. From age 10, two or three students per instructor, no experience needed.

steps.label: 3 days
steps.text: Open Water Diver. The first full certification: digital learning, then theory and pool on day 1 and four open water dives on days 2 and 3, down to 18 metres with a certified buddy. From age 12. Divers from 10 take the Junior version, to 12 metres.

steps.label: 2 days
steps.text: Advanced Open Water Diver. Five adventure dives to work on buoyancy, navigation and deep diving, down to 30 metres. From age 15, for certified divers. A Junior version, to 21 metres, starts at 12.

steps.label: 3 days
steps.text: React Right and Stress and Rescue Diver, together in 3 days with 4 dives. React Right covers first aid, CPR, oxygen and emergency response. Stress and Rescue teaches you to recognise stress, prevent accidents and manage a rescue, with four rescue scenarios. From age 15, and the step before Divemaster.

steps.label: 2 days
steps.text: Deep Diver specialty. Five dives: two on a local trip, to 30 metres, then three on a special trip, to 40 metres. From age 15, and it pairs well with Nitrox.

steps.label: Theory only
steps.text: Nitrox specialty. Theory on enriched air, for longer bottom times and less tiredness after the dive. You add it to any day trip, with the Nitrox tanks and the dive computer included. From age 15.

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Fun dives for certified divers. Two dives at Koh Haa, which has 6 dive sites to choose from, or at Phi Phi and Koh Bida, which have more than 6. A maximum of four divers per group. Divers with no dive in the last year take a refresher first.

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Special trips by catamaran. Three dives for divers certified to Adventure Diver or Advanced, 30 metres at least, with a last dive within the past six months. The northern trip goes to the Kled Kaeo wreck, Koh Bida and Hin Klai and is back at 4.30 pm. The southern trip goes to Hin Daeng, Hin Muang and Koh Haa and is back at 5 pm.

steps.label: 1 day
steps.text: Snorkelling on the dive boat. Local sites only, for people who would rather stay at the surface while a family member dives. Children under 5 come free, and a nanny stays on board with younger children.

beforeYouBook.health: You must be medically fit to dive and fill in a medical questionnaire before diving.
beforeYouBook.children: 8 for the Scuba Explorer, 10 for the Discover Basic Diver, 12 for Open Water and 15 for the advanced courses and specialties. On the dive boat, snorkelling children under 5 come free and a nanny can stay on board.
beforeYouBook.weather: Every day depends on the weather and the sea, and you follow your instructor's safety instructions from start to finish.

faq.q: Do I need to have dived before?
faq.a: No. The Scuba Explorer and the one-day Discover Basic Diver are made for people who have never dived.

faq.q: Does the instructor speak my language?
faq.a: The instructors speak several languages. Tell us on WhatsApp which language you need and we check before you book.
5 metres for the kids, 12 metres on the one-day dive. Once you are Open Water certified it is 18 metres, and 30 metres after Advanced Open Water. The Deep Diver specialty goes to 40 metres.

If you have one day and have never dived, take the Discover Basic Diver: two dives to 12 metres with an instructor, from age 10. Children from 8 can try the Scuba Explorer. If you want to keep diving on future holidays, the three-day Open Water course certifies you to dive to 18 metres. If you are already certified, join a dive trip to Koh Haa or Phi Phi. Send us your dates, everyone's age and who is already certified, and we will tell you which one fits.
8 for the Scuba Explorer, 10 for the Discover Basic Diver, 12 for Open Water and 15 for the advanced courses and specialties.

legacyText.title: Scuba Diving Koh Lanta, Courses and Dives | Secret Travel
intro: Nobody needs experience for the one-day Discover Basic Diver. You learn the basics in shallow water, then make two dives with your instructor, two or three students per instructor (two at most on the Scuba Explorer, from age 8). The courses go on from there, up to Advanced Open Water, rescue and specialties, with four students at most per class.
The one-day dives are at Koh Haa, or Phi Phi and Koh Bida. Every day depends on the weather and the sea, and you follow your instructor's safety instructions from start to finish.
legacyText.cardDescription: Try diving for a day, or train from Open Water up to advanced and rescue. Small groups.
goodToKnow: Not included: the National Park fee when you dive at Koh Haa, Hin Daeng or Phi Phi, and the optional diving insurance, 150 THB per day. The fee is 600 THB for an adult and 400 THB for a child per diving day.
You must be medically fit to dive and fill in a medical questionnaire before diving.
Bring swimwear, a towel, reef-safe sunscreen, sunglasses and a change of clothes.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht, per person. The National Park fee (adult 600 THB, child 400 THB per diving day; snorkellers and passengers pay 400 and 200) and the optional diving insurance, 150 THB per day, are not included.
